name: AllPays.co – Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: AllPays.co

sections.description:
AllPays.co Payment Gateway for WooCommerce enables your store to accept various payment methods including credit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Venmo, Revolut, Robinhood bank transfers, and cryptocurrencies – all without requiring registration or KYB process.

Key Features:

  • Multiple payment methods support
  • No registration required
  • Instant USDC payments
  • Built-in MPC wallet support
  • Compatible with both classic and block checkout
  • Automatic payment confirmation
  • Supports Block Checkout and Classic Checkout both

Supported Payment Methods:

  • Credit Cards
  • Apple Pay
  • Google Pay
  • Revolut
  • Venmo
  • Bank Transfer
  • And more…

Additional Info

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data. All payment requests are redirected securely by AllPays.co and handled by it’s payment providers. Privacy Policy

Support

For more information and support inquiries, please visit AllPays.co Support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/allpaysco-payment-gateway-for-woocommerce
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > AllPays.co Settings or Go to AllPays.co from admin menu
  4. Enable AllPays.co and configure your POLYGON wallet address
  5. Select your Payment Mode(“Payment Methods”, “Payment Providers”)
  6. Enable the providers you want to use
  7. Enable the payments from classic WooCommerce Payments page which appears through your Gateway Mode.
sections.faq:
Does this require registration?

No, you only need a POLYGON wallet address to receive payments.

Which payment methods are supported?

We support Credit Cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut, Venmo, Bank Transfer, and various payment methods.

Is KYB (Know Your Business) required?

No, AllPays.co doesn’t require KYB process. You can start accepting payments immediately.

How do I receive payments?

Payments are automatically converted to USDC and sent to your POLYGON wallet address.
